privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Personal data protection and GDPR compliance
privacy.section1Content: The application uses a managed relational database (Neon) to record and persist user preferences. Collected information includes:
privacy.pref1: Display preferences (language, default OS, package manager, preferred terminal).
privacy.pref2: History of recently analyzed GitHub repositories (strictly capped at 10 records per account).
privacy.pref3: Collaborative annotations added by users on analyzed source files.
privacy.section2WarningContent: The Personal Access Token (PAT) provided by the user to bypass GitHub API limits is encrypted end-to-end with the **AES-256** symmetric encryption algorithm before being persisted in the Neon database. This token is never shared with third parties, is never shown in clear text on the UI after save, and is strictly used to perform authenticated requests to the GitHub API on your behalf.
privacy.section3Content: In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to access, rectify, and completely delete your personal information at any time. You can request the immediate and permanent deletion of your account and all associated data from your profile or by written request.

cgu.title: Terms of Service
cgu.subtitle: Rules and terms of use of the platform
cgu.section1Content: Code Memory is a software architecture analysis tool for Git repositories. The service is provided free of charge for evaluation and technical documentation of projects.
cgu.section2Content: The platform is provided **"as is"**. [SASU EliDev](https://eli-dev.fr/) does not warrant continuous availability of the tool, API response times, or absolute accuracy of automated architectural diagnostics provided by the static analyzer.
cgu.section3Content: The user is solely responsible for the source code submitted for analysis or annotation. [SASU EliDev](https://eli-dev.fr/) declines all responsibility regarding access rights or intellectual property of Git repositories analyzed via the platform by users.
